summary: Re-establish multi-sport habit: five short weekday sessions plus first meaningful 60-min Saturday ride; first run of the block introduced; strength at 2 rounds to gauge response.

sessions.name: Short Aerobic Spin
sessions.focus: Aerobic base maintenance, easy Z2 habit session

steps.description: Z1 easy unloaded spin, cadence 85-90 rpm, HR <140 bpm
Z2 steady aerobic effort, cadence 88-92 rpm, HR 145-158 bpm, conversational pace
Z1 full unload, HR back below 130 bpm before stopping

sessions.name: Easy Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Active recovery, blood flow, aerobic system at minimal cost

steps.description: Z1 very easy, cadence 90-95 rpm, just loosening up
Z1-low Z2 recovery effort, cadence 90+ rpm, HR under 150 bpm throughout
Z1 wind fully down, HR under 125 bpm

sessions.name: Aerobic Spin with Cadence Work
sessions.focus: Aerobic base development with neuromuscular cadence stimulus

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, build cadence gradually to 90 rpm
Z2 aerobic block, cadence 92-95 rpm, HR 147-160 bpm
Z1 easy spin cadence reset, HR settle
Z1 easy spin, HR back under 135 bpm

sessions.name: Easy Run — First Run of the Block
sessions.focus: Re-introduce running, pure Z1-Z2 aerobic, no pace pressure

steps.description: Z1 walk/easy jog, <145 bpm, transition from walk to shuffle as HR allows
Z1-Z2 easy run, 140-158 bpm, conversational effort — walk 60s if HR exceeds 160 bpm, keep shoulders relaxed and arms low
Easy walk cool-down, HR fully down, brief calf and hip flexor stretch

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Shoulder-Modified
sessions.focus: Lower body strength endurance and core stability, zero shoulder load
sessions.notes: 2 rounds: 12x goblet squat 16kg, 10x Romanian deadlift 16kg dumbbells, 10x TRX split squat per leg (TRX for balance only), 15x banded glute bridge (mini band above knees), 8x dead bug per side. 60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds. No overhead movements, no shoulder pressing or pulling. Dead bug replaces plank to keep shoulder unloaded.

steps.description: Leg swings forward and lateral 10 each, mini-band lateral walks 2x10 steps, bodyweight squats 10 reps slow
12x goblet squat 16kg (3s lower), 10x Romanian deadlift 16kg, 10x TRX split squat per leg, 15x banded glute bridge, 8x dead bug per side. 60s rest between exercises.
90s rest between rounds — walk around, shake legs out
Hip flexor stretch kneeling 30s per side, seated hamstring stretch 30s per side, figure-4 glute stretch 30s per side

sessions.name: Aerobic Foundation Ride
sessions.focus: Longest aerobic stimulus of the week — sustained Z2 base building

steps.description: Z1 progressive build: first 5 min under 90W, next 5 min build to 100-105W, cadence 88-90 rpm
Z2 sustained aerobic effort, target avg 120-130W, HR stabilise 148-160 bpm after first 10 min, cadence 88-92 rpm — if HR climbs above 163 bpm ease off 5-10W
Z1 full unload, HR below 130 bpm before stopping, stretch quads and hip flexors

summary: Extend base volume: Saturday ride grows to 60+ min with first structured cadence or light tempo variation; strength moves to 3 rounds; second run session introduced or existing run extended to 35 min.

sessions.name: Aerobic Spin — Extended
sessions.focus: Z2 base, slight power progression from week 1

sessions.name: Easy Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Z1 active recovery

sessions.name: Cadence & Tempo Introduction
sessions.focus: First taste of Z3 (142-168W) with short 5-min blocks, still mostly Z2

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Run
sessions.focus: Z1-Z2 run, extend to 35 min, relaxed HR control

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — 3 Rounds
sessions.focus: Progress to 3 rounds, introduce 22kg goblet squat if ready

sessions.name: Aerobic Base Ride — Volume Step
sessions.focus: 50 min continuous Z2, build aerobic duration

summary: Transition to build: introduce first genuine threshold intervals on cycling (2x10 min Z4); run extends to 40 min with a short Z3 tempo segment; strength consolidates at 3 rounds with load progression.

sessions.name: Aerobic Spin

sessions.name: Easy Recovery Spin

sessions.name: Threshold Introduction — 2x10 min
sessions.focus: First Z4 threshold blocks (169-185W), 5 min recovery between, aerobic wrap

sessions.focus: 35 min Z2 with 2x3 min Z3 tempo inserts, HR-controlled

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Load Progression
